levelLaw: Levels execute in order. Additions are allowed but never silently reorder completed currency.
currencyLaw: Level 1 jobs are fast-moving polished currency: small, deterministic, reusable, independently tested and cheap to repeat.
cycleLaw: INTAKE -> ATLAS/MNEMOSYNE STOCK CHECK -> PLAN -> BUILD/REUSE -> TALOS -> REPEAT/FAULT -> BLOCK DISPOSITION -> INDEX -> LESSON
promotionLaw: A training job does not admit a Block. Admission requires reusable contract, independent proof, provenance, no duplicate owner and explicit library disposition.

levels.name: Atomic Currency
levels.goal: Tiny deterministic, polished, dependency-light utilities. One bounded input/output contract; minutes not days.

levels.name: Stateful Currency
levels.goal: Small local state, CRUD, import/export, settings, trackers and dashboards.

levels.name: Small Applications
levels.goal: Complete single-purpose apps, static sites, extensions and local-first tools.

levels.name: Connected Applications
levels.goal: Auth, databases, storage, APIs, email, search, PWA/offline and external integrations.

levels.name: AI Applications
levels.goal: Extraction, classification, summarization, transcription, RAG and bounded inference workflows.

levels.name: Automation Systems
levels.goal: Scheduled and event-driven multi-step workflows with approvals, monitoring and recovery.

levels.name: Production Products
levels.goal: Multi-user SaaS, commerce, community, booking and business systems with production rails.

levels.name: Oros Systems
levels.goal: Composed products assembled substantially from admitted Great Library Blocks and Blueprints.

levels.name: Autonomous Construction
levels.goal: Requirement to research, blueprint, compose, build, verify, repair and release under operator gates.

levels.name: Recursive OTHRYS
levels.goal: OTHRYS safely improves OTHRYS: identifies missing primitives, proves reuse, extracts Blocks and learns without drift.
